compiled_state.title: Cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification (BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings, max_cycles, parity local+PR)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

Today's code review pipeline has two arbiter mechanisms (`ESCALATE_REVIEW` tier escalation + `code-reviewer-arbiter` per-finding severity-dispute adjudicator) plus an unbounded cycle counter, with no clear cycle-K decision point. The local merge strategy and PR merge strategy use overlapping-but-divergent code paths.

## Scope

Unifies these into a single cycle-end arbiter pattern with parity for local + PR modes. Adds `review.max_cycles` config knob (default 4). On cycle K (or earlier via adaptive stability detection), arbiter dispatches once with consolidated input (current unresolved findings + per-cycle ledger + external-reviewer findings from `gh api`) and produces per-finding BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings using an 8-category impact policy floor. Old per-finding severity-dispute callsite removed. `ESCALATE_REVIEW` within-cycle tier escalation preserved as orthogonal. Chain-of-Verification riding on the existing context-aug loop upgrades the verifier for high-severity findings.

## Approach (to be brainstormed)

- Rewrite `code-reviewer-arbiter.md` with the cycle-end role (new output schema with `impact_class`, `cross_reviewer_agreement[]`, `cross_cycle_pattern[]`)
- Add adaptive stability detection (Jaccard delta over `(file, line_range, severity_bucket)` tuples, halt-on-stability before max_cycles when applicable)
- Wire arbiter into REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (PR path) and `/dso:commit` (local path) with identical dispatch and output handling; terminal effects differ only at the gate boundary
- Remove the existing severity-dispute callsite from the resolve/defend gate

## Dependencies

- Story A `1ef8-79c4-6195-4c98` (proximity matcher) provides the `cited_lines` proximity infrastructure used for cross-cycle finding identification.

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>`.
